settings.modeHint: Mode switches live (no reboot). Servo runs the motor controller. RTU Relay bridges framed Modbus on TCP :502 and /ws/modbus. RS-485 is a raw byte pipe on USB ACM and /ws/rs485 (CLI is unavailable on USB in that mode).
settings.relayTelemetryUnavailable: Motor update-rate telemetry is not available in RTU relay or RS-485 transceiver mode.
settings.modbusDebugHint: 5 ms RX deadline + MODBUS_DBG class/hex on USB console (256 B DMA). Restart required. Collapses motor update rate — disable after diagnosis.
